title: They put a paywall on the sky.
caption: Someone put a paywall on the sky. One coin, one tiny twinkle. Two coins, half a twinkle. Third coin, spat back out. Babe, it's the sky. So the gold star broke the padlock. Who else refuses to pay to be seen?
